summary: The active DeviceMatrix path either repeatedly launches the width-selected sparse kernel or, for ordered output, uses its ordered kernel path. The timed execute loop submits floor(iterations/batchIterations) graph batches plus the remainder launches. Compiled host control retains capture, graph replay, and remainder loops; emitted SASS contains indexed sparse arithmetic, backedges, and stores across all selectable Width variants and both ordered modes.

source_evidence.claim: makeMatrix constructs local CSR data from rank-local rows and global nonzero prefix; spmvKernel and orderedSpmvKernel traverse sparse entries and store row results; DeviceMatrix selects width/ordered paths, captures batchIterations calls, and execute replays batches plus residual multiplies; main partitions rows by rank, parses -i, prepares, and executes the timed workload.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled run constructs and prepares DeviceMatrix; the graph capture loop repeatedly calls multiply and checks its batch counter; the timed path calls cudaGraphLaunch in a counted loop, then calls multiply for a counted remainder and synchronizes; multiply dispatches among specialized kernel paths.
